entries.title: A card's × asks about your unsent picks on the first press, even right after its question closed
entries.body: When a card has picks you have not sent, its × asks before closing it. Pressing × just as that question finished fading away showed nothing: the next press closed the hidden question, and only a third press showed it. Now the first press shows the question. The same fix applies to the update panel, the ⋯ menus and command search.
entries.noPicture: The question looks as it always did; the fix is to a press at one moment of its fade-out, which a still picture cannot show.
